summary: postinstall fetches and installs an executable from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall hook runs ensurePlatformBinary, which downloads a platform tarball from the hardcoded bare-IP URL https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/onecode-<ver>/onecode-linux-x64-<ver>.tgz, extracts it under node_modules/onecode-<platform>-<arch>/, chmods the extracted binary to 0755, and hardlinks it to bin/.onecode so the onecode launcher executes it. The HTTPS request is issued with rejectUnauthorized:false, disabling certificate validation, and there is no hash or signature verification of the downloaded bytes. The destination is a bare IPv4 address rather than a publisher-owned domain, and no version pinning or integrity check protects the payload. Any operator of that IP address, or any network attacker positioned between an installer and that host, can substitute arbitrary code that will run on every subsequent invocation of the package's CLI on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
